page: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v6 is an Eadv6-family virtual machine instance configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 AMD processor architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server type features 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 7.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. It does not include any GPU accelerators.

For local storage, the instance is equipped with 5669 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing high-speed local read and write capabilities. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external disk options. The configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The high memory-to-core ratio and substantial local NVMe storage make this instance highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring large memory footprints and fast local scratch space without the overhead of dedicated GPU hardware. This profile is well-suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and data-intensive processing pipelines.
